description: Isolated, always-warm job that manages one or more cron schedules in-process, bypassing Dagster's SchedulerDaemon entirely (its minute-granular tick evaluation is architectural, not a load artifact -- confirmed against the Dagster OSS scheduler source, which Dagster+'s control plane subclasses unchanged). Warms up once per bounded run (load a model, open connections), then fires each job's tick_fn as a direct in-process function call at each precise scheduled instant -- never through Dagster's run-launching APIs, which is what makes each tick instant and keeps the process genuinely isolated (dedicated resources, not the shared code-location server). Supports a single job (flat asset_name/schedule/tick_fn fields) or several independently-scheduled jobs sharing ONE warm process and ONE warmup pass (the `jobs` list) -- each job still gets its own AssetKey/materialization history. By default, each job's real cadence is also documented as a default-STOPPED, non-firing Dagster ScheduleDefinition (targeting a harmless no-op marker asset, never the real automation) so it's visible in the Schedules tab. Pair with StreamingRunHealthSensorComponent, unmodified, for auto-restart.

outputs.description: Summary dict + one AssetMaterialization per scheduled tick (with measured drift against the scheduled instant)

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Single-job mode only: output asset name (also used by the paired health sensor's asset_selection). Required when `jobs` is not set.

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.description: Single-job mode only: a cron string. Standard 5-field by default (e.g. '*/15 * * * *'). Evaluated by this component's own internal loop via croniter -- NOT a Dagster ScheduleDefinition, never handed to the SchedulerDaemon. Set second_precision: true for 6-field (seconds-leading) cron, e.g. '*/30 * * * * *' for every 30 seconds -- a granularity Dagster's native scheduler can never express at all. Required when `jobs` is not set.

second_precision.label: Second Precision
second_precision.description: Single-job mode only: parse `schedule` as 6-field cron (seconds-leading) instead of standard 5-field.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/New_York') the cron string(s) are evaluated in. Component-level default; a `jobs` entry may override with its own `timezone`.

warmup_fn.label: Warmup Function
warmup_fn.description: 'module.path:function_name', called ONCE per bounded run (not per tick, and shared across every job in `jobs` if set) as `warmup_fn(context) -> Any`. Return value passed as warm_state to every job's tick_fn call in this run. Optional.

tick_fn.label: Tick Function
tick_fn.description: Single-job mode only: 'module.path:function_name', called once per precise scheduled tick as `tick_fn(context, warm_state, scheduled_time) -> Optional[dict]`, as a direct in-process function call -- never through Dagster's run-launching APIs. Required when `jobs` is not set.

jobs.label: Jobs
jobs.description: Multi-job mode: a list of independently-scheduled automations ({asset_name, schedule, tick_fn} required; optional per-entry overrides for second_precision/timezone/max_ticks/catchup/max_catchup_ticks/tick_error_handling/description/group_name/asset_tags/kinds/owners/deps -- falls back to this component's matching top-level value when omitted) sharing this ONE warm process and ONE warmup_fn pass. Mutually exclusive with the flat asset_name/schedule/tick_fn fields -- set exactly one of `jobs` or `tick_fn`.

expose_informational_schedules.label: Expose Informational Schedules
expose_informational_schedules.description: Emit a real, default-STOPPED Dagster ScheduleDefinition per job whose schedule is standard 5-field cron (not second_precision), purely so the real cadence is visible in the Schedules tab. Targets a trivial no-op marker asset, never the real warm automation -- safe even if flipped to RUNNING or manually launched. Set false to suppress entirely.

op_name.label: Op Name
op_name.description: Multi-job mode only: the underlying op's name (defaults to 'warm_scheduled_jobs_multi'). Set this if you have more than one multi-job WarmScheduledJobComponent instance in the same code location, to avoid an op-name collision.

max_seconds.label: Max Seconds
max_seconds.description: Bounded run duration for the WHOLE process (shared across every job in `jobs`). `null` = unbounded (runs until killed; health sensor auto-restarts). Bounded re-pays the warmup cost once per window, not once per tick.

max_ticks.label: Max Ticks
max_ticks.description: Single-job mode only (per-job override available in `jobs` entries): optional cap on total ticks executed before exit (in addition to max_seconds).

catchup.label: Catchup
catchup.description: Single-job mode only (per-job override available in `jobs` entries). Default (false): if behind schedule, skip straight to the next FUTURE tick. true: execute every missed tick back-to-back (bounded by max_catchup_ticks).

max_catchup_ticks.label: Max Catchup Ticks
max_catchup_ticks.description: Single-job mode only (per-job override available in `jobs` entries): safety cap on consecutive missed ticks executed back-to-back when catchup=true.

tick_error_handling.label: Tick Error Handling
tick_error_handling.description: Single-job mode only (per-job override available in `jobs` entries). 'continue' (default): a tick_fn exception is logged + reported as a failed-tick materialization, loop continues. 'raise': the exception fails the WHOLE run immediately -- in multi-job mode, every job sharing this instance stops with it.

group_name.description: Component-level default group_name; a `jobs` entry may override with its own `group_name`.
group_name.label: Group Name

description.description: Single-job mode only (per-job override available in `jobs` entries).
description.label: Description

asset_tags.description: Component-level default asset_tags; a `jobs` entry may override with its own `asset_tags`.
asset_tags.label: Tags

kinds.description: Component-level default kinds; a `jobs` entry may override with its own `kinds`.
kinds.label: Kinds

owners.description: Component-level default owners; a `jobs` entry may override with its own `owners`.
owners.label: Owners

deps.description: Component-level default deps (lineage-only upstream asset keys, no data passed at runtime); a `jobs` entry may override with its own `deps`.
deps.label: Lineage Deps
